subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` make reattach-and-replay the default response to an accepted Gateway disconnect before retaining the current automatic isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: This is a deliberate user-visible tradeoff between authoritative single-run recovery and the current immediate rerun/streaming behavior; source inspection cannot choose that CLI product contract.

options.title: Sponsor reattach-first recovery
options.body: Approve the branch direction, then require final-head live proof for successful recovery, cached terminal failures, capability rejection, and recovery exhaustion before merge.

options.title: Keep current fallback policy
options.body: Retain the current isolated automatic fallback and close or narrow this PR rather than introducing the new replay contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Approve the branch direction, then require final-head live proof for successful recovery, cached terminal failures, capability rejection, and recovery exhaustion before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main fallback behavior was introduced through the merged containment change in this code path.
